name: moment
paper_title: MOMENT: A Family of Open Time-series Foundation Models
authors: Mononito Goswami, Konrad Szafer, Arjun Choudhry, Yifu Cai, Shuo Li, Artur Dubrawski
venue: International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024), PMLR Vol. 235
license: Code: MIT (repo). Paper: arXiv CC BY 4.0. Weights: on HuggingFace (AutonLab/MOMENT-1-large/base/small).
notes: Time-series foundation model (T5-style masked-reconstruction transformer, patch tokenization). Pre-trained on the 'Time series Pile' corpus. Three sizes: small/base/large (weights on HuggingFace under AutonLab/MOMENT-1-*). General-purpose across forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, imputation. In HALO this is a DROPPED baseline (too slow per data/baseline strategy memo) — kept only for related-work citation. arXiv v1 Feb 2024, v3 Oct 2024; accepted at ICML 2024. PDF verified: 38 pages, title/authors match seed.
